remarks: Awesome Brick Ranch located in a highly desirable Village neighborhood. 3/4 acre fenced lot is located on a cul de sac and features a 700 sq ft 3 car garage, plenty of parking , rear patio and a storage shed. All this is in close proximaty to the beautiful Como Park and Village of Lancaster restaurants and shopping. Totally remodeled home was gutted down to the studs. New drywall, insulation, flooring, carpeting,  high efficieny gas heating, new ductwork, central air conditioning, tankless water heater, sump pump,  pex plumbing, 200 amp electical panel, new wiring, modern and recessed lighting, ceiling fans, new kitchen with appliances and totally refreshed bathrooms and many new windows. The 3 bedrooms are generously sized with lighted closets and the living/dining combination room is perfect for entertaining or holiday gatherings. The huge Great Room features a vaulted ceiling and is perfect for a host of activities.  The freshly painted and carpeted basement offers a large flex space with almost unlimited options. Make sure you don't miss out on this one.
